title: Voting Rights and Electoral Integrity
question_text: What proof of identity or citizenship should a person have to show to vote?

stances.text: Require no proof of identity to vote.
Accept non-photo documents, such as a utility bill or bank statement, as voter ID.
Require photo ID to vote, with a sworn statement for a voter who has none.
Require ID before a ballot counts: photo ID at the polls, or an ID number or a copy of an ID with each mail ballot.
Require documentary proof of citizenship to register or to vote.
